decisions.reason: The commission trigger, recipient, payout destination, timing, and cap do not change the existing 4 Small and 3 Big ticket issuance rule.
Clarifying commission behavior for referral-coded mints does not alter ticket allocation for mints without a referral code.
The commission decision relies on the referral code but does not change its token-serial identity, permanence, or display locations.
The commission payout semantics do not change any NFT metadata field or visibility requirement.
The source decision does not specify any change to book access, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state when an NFT transfers.

The $10 affiliate amount is already represented, while the source decision adds operational details owned by the atomic coded-referral commission Requirement without changing mint price or allocation amounts.
The FAQ Requirement already requires loading the complete supplied copy, so the commission details within that copy do not require a separate propagated state change.
Automatic wallet transfer of referral commissions does not modify the separate manual one-click claim flow for prize winnings.
Requiring a wallet as the destination for affiliate commissions does not change the rule that buyers can complete Transak fiat minting without a preexisting wallet or cryptocurrency.
The coded-referral commission decision does not change badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
Commission payout details do not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, eligibility, pool trigger, or royalty funding.
The referral commission decision does not change the secondary-sale royalty amount, enforcement, disclosure, pool contribution, or ticket behavior.
